description: Hand-labelled claim/passage pairs for calibrating the claim-support thresholds in src/lib/verify/claims.ts. A pair is `supports: true` when the passage, read on its own, would let a reasonable person say the claim is stated by this source. IMPORTANT: this is a development set, written by hand to span the decision boundary. It is not a held-out benchmark, and numbers measured on it are calibration figures, not an accuracy claim. The honest next step is to add pairs sampled from real briefings, labelled by someone who did not write the thresholds.

kinds.paraphrase: positive — the same fact in different words
kinds.embedded: positive — the fact is stated inside a longer passage about other things
kinds.partial: positive — stated, but with less precision than the claim
kinds.adjacent: negative — same topic, a neighbouring fact, not this one
kinds.contradictory: negative — the passage states the opposite or a different magnitude
kinds.generic: negative — boilerplate about the domain that asserts nothing specific

pairs.claim: Roughly a third of food prepared in college hostel messes is thrown away.
pairs.passage: Surveys of residential campus kitchens found that about 33 percent of cooked food never reaches a plate and is discarded at the end of service.

pairs.claim: Demand forecasting reduces over-preparation in canteens.
pairs.passage: The pilot ran for eleven weeks across four sites. Staff logged headcount each evening. Where kitchens used the forecast to set batch sizes, over-preparation fell noticeably compared with the control sites, though procurement costs were unchanged and the labour saving was marginal.

pairs.claim: Roughly a third of food prepared in college hostel messes is thrown away.
pairs.passage: Hostel kitchens across the state now separate wet waste at source, and composting units installed in 2023 process the residue on site rather than sending it to landfill.

pairs.claim: Hostel food waste costs Indian campuses around 40 crore rupees a year.
pairs.passage: The report puts the annual cost of avoidable food waste in institutional catering at roughly 4 crore rupees nationally, a figure the authors describe as conservative.

pairs.claim: Roughly a third of food prepared in college hostel messes is thrown away.
pairs.passage: Food waste is an important challenge facing institutions today. Many organisations are exploring ways to become more sustainable and reduce their environmental footprint.

pairs.claim: Soil moisture sensors let farmers water only when the crop needs it.
pairs.passage: By reading moisture at root depth, the controller withholds irrigation until the soil drops below a set point, so water is applied on demand rather than on a fixed schedule.

pairs.claim: Drip irrigation cuts water use in sugarcane by about 40 percent.
pairs.passage: Growers switching from flood to drip reported water savings in the region of forty per cent for cane, alongside a modest yield gain.

pairs.claim: Soil moisture sensors let farmers water only when the crop needs it.
pairs.passage: Capacitive soil sensors degrade in saline conditions and require recalibration every season, which has limited their adoption among smallholders.

pairs.claim: Drip irrigation cuts water use in sugarcane by about 40 percent.
pairs.passage: Trials found drip made little difference to total water applied for cane, with savings under five per cent once system losses were accounted for.

pairs.claim: Emergency departments in tier-2 cities routinely operate beyond their rated capacity.
pairs.passage: Casualty wards in smaller cities are consistently over their sanctioned bed strength, with occupancy above one hundred per cent for most of the year.

pairs.claim: Nurses spend a significant share of a shift on paperwork rather than patients.
pairs.passage: Time-and-motion observation across three wards produced a familiar picture. Handover took twenty minutes. Medication rounds were efficient. But documentation consumed close to a third of each shift, time that observers noted was drawn directly from bedside care.

pairs.claim: Nurses spend a significant share of a shift on paperwork rather than patients.
pairs.passage: Nursing vacancies in the district stood at eighteen per cent last year, and the hospital has struggled to retain staff beyond their second year of service.

pairs.claim: Emergency departments in tier-2 cities routinely operate beyond their rated capacity.
pairs.passage: Healthcare delivery is a complex undertaking requiring coordination between many stakeholders. Improving patient outcomes remains a central goal for administrators everywhere.

pairs.claim: Face recognition attendance systems fail more often for darker skin tones.
pairs.passage: Error rates in the tested systems were markedly higher for subjects with darker skin, with false rejection several times the rate recorded for the lightest group.

pairs.claim: Face recognition attendance systems fail more often for darker skin tones.
pairs.passage: Across the evaluated vendors, accuracy was consistent between demographic groups, and the authors found no statistically significant difference by skin tone.

pairs.claim: Face recognition attendance systems fail more often for darker skin tones.
pairs.passage: Several institutions have replaced biometric attendance with RFID cards after students objected to storing facial templates on college servers.

pairs.claim: Real-time bus tracking increases ridership on suburban routes.
pairs.passage: Where live arrival information was introduced, passenger numbers on outer routes rose over the following year, an effect the authors attribute to reduced waiting uncertainty.

pairs.claim: GPS units on public buses report position every ten to fifteen seconds.

pairs.claim: Real-time bus tracking increases ridership on suburban routes.

pairs.claim: GPS units on public buses report position every ten to fifteen seconds.
pairs.passage: Modern transit systems rely on a range of technologies to improve the passenger experience and make services more reliable and easier to use.

pairs.claim: UPI transaction volume has grown faster than card payments in India.
pairs.passage: Unified Payments Interface volumes have expanded at a considerably steeper rate than debit and credit card transactions over the same period.

pairs.claim: Small merchants adopt digital payments mainly to avoid handling cash.
pairs.passage: Interviews with two hundred shopkeepers covered pricing, credit and staffing. On payments, the dominant reason given for accepting QR codes was not customer demand or cost but simply not wanting cash on the premises at closing time.

pairs.claim: Small merchants adopt digital payments mainly to avoid handling cash.

pairs.claim: Rooftop solar payback periods in India are typically under six years.

pairs.claim: Classroom air quality worsens measurably by the end of a lesson.

pairs.claim: Urban flooding in Indian cities is driven more by blocked drains than by rainfall intensity.
pairs.passage: Analysis of flood events found that drainage obstruction, rather than the severity of the rain itself, explained most of the waterlogging recorded in the study area.

pairs.claim: Urban flooding in Indian cities is driven more by blocked drains than by rainfall intensity.

pairs.claim: Return rates in online apparel are far higher than in other categories.
pairs.passage: Clothing sees returns at a multiple of the rate observed for electronics or household goods, largely because of sizing.

pairs.claim: Leaf-image models can diagnose common crop diseases from a phone photograph.

pairs.claim: Leaf-image models can diagnose common crop diseases from a phone photograph.

pairs.claim: Students say mess menus are decided without consulting them.
pairs.passage: Residents reported that the weekly menu is fixed by the contractor and warden with no student input, a complaint raised repeatedly in feedback sessions.

pairs.claim: Headcount for dinner is far less predictable than for lunch.
pairs.passage: Kitchen records were examined over a full term. Breakfast attendance was stable. Lunch varied within a narrow range tied to the timetable. The evening meal was the difficult one: numbers swung widely from night to night with no pattern the staff could anticipate.

pairs.claim: Headcount for dinner is far less predictable than for lunch.
